test_title: PYST 58: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held  on 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been divided into four segments. Identify the segment that has a grammatical error.

When he resigned, / the company offered him / a huge sum of money but / he refused to agree to it.

options.text: a huge sum of money but
he refused to agree to it.

solution:
The correct answer is ** Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the third part of the given sentence, the phrase 'refused to agree to it' is redundant.
 
• In the given sentence, the verb **'refused'** already implies **not agreeing**. So the correct word should be '**he refused'.**
 
• Therefore, the phrase **'refused to agree to it'** should be **revised** to avoid **redundancy.**
 
 
• **Example:** ***He refused the offer*.**
 
 

Hence, the correct statement is **"*When he resigned, the company offered him a huge sum of money but he refused."__***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• If the **sentence contains redundant phrases** that **repeat the same idea**, it is **best to revise** the sentence for clarity.

 
 
• **Example:** *The manager **approved** the proposal **and gave his consent**.* (This can be revised to *The manager approved the proposal*.)
 
 
 
• Always aim for **conciseness** in writing to make your point **clear and effective**.
 
 
• Example: *She **returned back** the book.* (This can be revised to *She returned the book*.)
